briefing.text: Information Technology stays first on all three feeds, but attention is cooling: News buzz 81.0 (-4.0 on the day, -1.4 on the week, mentions -70%, sentiment -0.03), X buzz 92.6 (-0.4, mentions -49%, sentiment 0.09) and Reddit buzz 94.1 (-1.0, +0.3 on the week, mentions -34%, sentiment -0.04), led by NVDA, MSFT, AMD, AVGO, MU. On News the biggest drops are Materials (buzz 66.7, -10.8, mentions -76%; CBT, FCX, NEM) and Financials (68.4, -9.9; BAC, UBS, MS). On X, Utilities is the one riser (buzz 82.5, +2.4, mentions +17%, sentiment 0.28; VST, CEG, DUK), while Financial Services fell 17.6 to 27.6 on a thin PAXG-only base. On Reddit, Financials moved from rank 5 to 2 (buzz 91.1, +0.4, +2.4 on the week; MS, BRK, GS, SOFI), while Healthcare dropped 35.1 to 28.9 on a MEDS-only base.

ADI #2: 7 articles in 2 days, mostly neutral (one stake disclosure, one chip-selloff piece); earnings are 11-24, which fits the jump from #17.
SKHY #3: 19 articles, 8 positive and 4 negative, mostly general AI/chip commentary; the stock is -13.1% on the day, so the move explains the rank more than the news.
DKS #5: 7 articles, 4 negative, on Nike-related sales weakness and a fair-value piece; earnings 11-24 is the likelier driver.
ZS #6: 15 articles, 9 positive, including a headline about what investors got wrong before the drop; attention is the strongest input here.
KR #7: 5 articles, 2 negative, including a report of about 3,000 white-collar layoffs; earnings 12-03.
NVDA #8: 325 articles, 67 negative vs 30 positive; headlines cite Jensen Huang resigning amid an SEC accounting probe, and the stock is -14.0% on the day, which clearly explains the ranking.
MSTR #9: 5 articles, all negative, covering an oversold bounce and MSCI cutting Strategy from its indexes; stock -9.7%.
SOFI #13: 4 articles, 1 negative, on a new 52-week low; stock -7.7%.

BJ stays #1 (score 0.916) on volume running well above normal (1.37) and a 3.6-sigma price move, with attention on X and overall attention in high percentiles; there is no catalyst date, only a Kalshi foot-traffic market. ADI (#2, up from #17) pairs a 2.1-sigma move and 96th-percentile volume with attention on X at the 95th percentile and an earnings catalyst on 11-24. SK hynix (#3, up from #20) is driven by a 13.1% one-day drop (2.1 sigmas), X attention at the 94th percentile and heavy X mentions (135); it has no listed catalyst. Most of the top 3 are price-move and X-attention stories rather than Reddit or news-led.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
